title: Bifrost Workspace Semantic-Pack Activation
description: The shared .bifrost/packs.json document read by the CLI, MCP, and LSP hosts. The loader additionally enforces that catalog is a portable workspace-relative path and that the document is at most 256 KiB.

catalog.description: Optional workspace-relative catalog directory. When omitted, activation uses an ephemeral catalog. Absolute paths, parent components, and platform-prefixed paths are rejected by the loader.

ecosystems.description: Dependency ecosystems to activate. An empty array explicitly disables ambient dependency-pack activation; an absent document selects ecosystems serving languages present in the workspace.

enable.description: Optional pack IDs that satisfy a pack's review_required gate.
